subject.title: feat(codex): instrument dynamic-tool bridge phase timing

question: Should dynamic-tool bridge timing be retained as an always-on per-call info log in the Codex app-server client, or be kept in the existing diagnostic/trajectory surface with a more targeted log policy?
rationale: The implementation creates a durable operator-facing telemetry behavior whose volume, retention, and ownership cannot be settled from unit tests alone.

options.title: Use targeted diagnostic telemetry
options.body: Keep the timestamps in the existing trajectory/diagnostic path and avoid an always-on info record unless the Codex owners explicitly need it.

options.title: Accept per-call info logging
options.body: Retain the client-side info record after confirming its volume and operational value are acceptable for normal Codex dynamic-tool use.

recommendation.title: Use targeted diagnostic telemetry
recommendation.body: Keep the timestamps in the existing trajectory/diagnostic path and avoid an always-on info record unless the Codex owners explicitly need it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server work makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the runtime observability boundary.
